planner.hint: Production planner: from the items you need down to miners and pumps
planner.title: Production planner
planner.loadFailed: The recipe data could not be loaded.
planner.noData: This dataset has no recipe data (recipes.json). Build the dataset with --docs to use the planner.
planner.forYou: {value} of it for you, the rest goes into other steps
planner.external: Supplied from outside, not made in this plan.
planner.cycleHint: Part of a loop: these steps feed each other.
planner.roundedNote: Building counts are rounded up per step, with the exact count next to them. Power is for the exact count and the clock speed. By-products count against what other steps need; what is left is listed as surplus.
planner.variableNote: A range: some buildings' power varies during each cycle.
planner.wellNote: {item}: one {name} per resource well, {power} MW at {clock, number} %{shards, plural, =0 {} one {, # Power Shard} other {, # Power Shards}}; not included in the power.

error.cycle: These recipes form a loop that uses up at least as much as it makes: {items}. Choose another recipe for one of them, or have one supplied from outside.
error.invalidSettings: The extractor clock speed must be a number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
error.invalidClock: The clock speed for {item} must be a number from {min, number} to {max, number}.

planner.purityHint: Factors from the Satisfactory wiki (the game data has none). Applies to miners, oil extractors and resource well extractors, not to water extractors. Each step can have its own purity.
planner.clockHint: {min, number} % to {max, number} %: above 100 % each building needs a Power Shard per {per, number} % (up to {slots, number}). Default for all extractors; for a resource well it is the clock speed of its pressurizer. Production buildings run at 100 % unless set per step. Power follows the game's power exponent.
planner.shards: {count, plural, one {# Power Shard} other {# Power Shards}} per building
planner.autoLoop: Supplied from outside automatically: its default recipe would need the picked recipe's product again (a loop).
planner.noMachines: By-products of other steps cover it; no buildings needed.
planner.shardsPressurizer: {count, plural, one {# Power Shard} other {# Power Shards}} per {name}
planner.wellClock: The clock speed is set at the {name} and applies to all extractors of the resource well; the extractors themselves cannot be overclocked and need no power.

pick.hint: Choose a start and a destination on the map (a marker gives its position); the straight line between them becomes the route length.
pick.start: Vehicle calculator: choose the start on the map
pick.end: Vehicle calculator: now choose the destination

routeInfo.title: Route on the map
routeInfo.note: The route length is the straight line between the points: exact for drones. Wheeled vehicles follow roads and drive further, so for them it is a lower bound; enter the real length if you know it. Drag A or B on the map to move a point.
routeInfo.typed: The length was typed, so moving the points does not change it.

vehicleCalc.itemHint: Without an item the result is in stacks per minute.
vehicleCalc.itemUnknown: No item with this name. Pick one from the list.

speedDefault.pathLimit: Default from the game data: the autopilot's limit on a straight path ({speed, number} km/h). The real average is lower (curves, slopes, acceleration), so enter yours.
speedDefault.traction: Default from the game data: the speed at which the engine's tractive effort drops to zero ({speed, number} km/h); the autopilot's straight-path limit of {limit, number} km/h is out of reach. The real average is lower (curves, slopes, acceleration), so enter yours.
speedDefault.droneFuel: Default from the game data: the drone's travel speed with {fuel} ({speed, number} km/h). Take-off and landing are in the stop time.

vehicleCalc.speedMissing: Not in the game data. Enter the average speed you see in the game.
vehicleCalc.stop: Load and unload time per round trip

stopSource.truckStation: Default from the game data: one load/unload cycle of a Truck Station at each end ({seconds, number} s), whatever the vehicle carries. Driving into the station is not included.
stopSource.fluidTruckStation: Default from the game data: one load/unload cycle of a Fluid Truck Station at each end ({seconds, number} s). That one cycle moves the whole load is assumed, as at the Truck Station (not tested). Driving into the station is not included.
stopSource.freightPlatform: Default from the game data: a Freight Platform's load and unload time ({seconds, number} s). Braking and docking are not included.
stopSource.dronePort: Default from the game data: the drone's docking and take-off at both ports ({seconds, number} s).

vehicleCalc.stopMissing: Not in the game data. Enter how long the vehicle stops per round trip in total.

fuelHint.autopilot: Self-driving vehicles burn {perMetre, number} MJ per metre driven, there and back (game data: energy per cm, read as MJ). This fuel has {energy, number} MJ per item. The Tractor and the Explorer burn more when climbing, which is not included, so the result is an estimate.
fuelHint.dronePort: A round trip costs {trip, number} MJ for the take-offs and landings plus {perMetre, number} MJ per metre flown, there and back (Drone Port game data, in MJ as players tested it). This fuel has {energy, number} MJ per item.

vehicleCalc.freightCarNote: Counts freight cars. Cars in the same train share one round trip; locomotives are not counted.
